fullDescription: LUMIERE is a high-end, futuristic design system tailored for luxury hospitality, fine dining, and molecular gastronomy brands. It features a sophisticated dark-mode aesthetic with vibrant orange (#FF6B35) and gold (#FFD700) accents, using high-impact display typography (Cabinet Grotesk) and clean body text (Satoshi). The layout leverages 3D-inspired visuals, including floating objects with orbital animations, interactive tilt-cards with perspective transforms, and large border-radius containers (40px-60px) to create a soft yet technological feel. Suitable for boutique hotels, premium culinary experiences, high-end product showcases, and experimental design studios.
prompt:
## Resumo
A modern, immersive restaurant experience characterized by a dark #0A0A0A background, high-contrast orange accents, 3D floating food visualizations, and sleek interactive components using perspective-based mouse tracking.

## Estilo Visual
### Visual Identity & Style
- **Color Palette**: 
  - Background: #0A0A0A (Primary), #0F0F0F (Secondary Section), #1A1A1A (Cards)
  - Primary Accent: #FF6B35 (Orange)
  - Highlight: #FFD700 (Gold)
  - Text: #FFFFFF (Titles), #9CA3AF (Muted Body), #4B5563 (Darker Accents)
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: 'Cabinet Grotesk', Extrabold (800), tracking-tighter, font-size: 72px to 96px.
  - Body: 'Satoshi', Regular/Medium (400/500), font-size: 16px to 18px.
  - UI/Labels: 'Satoshi', Bold (700), uppercase, tracking-widest (0.2em), font-size: 10px to 12px.
- **Animations**:
  - **Floating**: `translateY(-20px)` over 6s with `ease-in-out` infinite loop.
  - **Spinning**: Orbital rings with `rotate(360deg)` over 12s linear.
  - **Tilt**: Perspective-based hover effects using `rotateX(5deg) rotateY(-5deg)` with `cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)` transition.
- **Borders & Shadows**:
  - Border Radius: 40px for cards, 60px for major sections/containers.
  - Shadows: Subtle glows using `box-shadow: 0 20px 50px -10px rgba(255, 107, 53, 0.2)`.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Floating 'Glassmorphism' navbar. Height: 80px. Background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.8) with 12px backdrop-blur. 1px bottom border in rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Left side: Logo with orange flame icon. Center: Uppercase tracking-widest text links in gray-400, hover: #FF6B35. Right side: Pill-shaped CTA button in white text/black background with high-speed hover transition.

### Hero Section
Two-column grid layout (1:1). Left column: Badge label (rounded-full, thin orange border), headline using #FFD700 to #FF6B35 gradient text, and a horizontal CTA block with an arrow icon. Right column: 3D interactive showcase. Central circular image (450px) with 20px float animation, surrounded by two concentric thin-line orbital rings rotating in opposite directions. Include floating UI 'badges' for ratings (9.8 Umami) and dish names with black/60 backdrop-blur.

### Signature Dishes Grid
Title section with left-aligned heading and right-aligned circular arrow navigation buttons. Below, a 3-column grid of 'Tilt Cards'. Each card: #1A1A1A background, 40px radius. Top half is a high-resolution image with a gradient-to-black bottom mask. Bottom half: Padding 32px, flex-row layout for title and price. Price text in #FF6B35, 24px font size.

### Storytelling Section
Asymmetrical layout. Left: Overlapping image composition. One large image container with 60px radius, rotated 3-degrees, sitting behind a foreground image rotated -3 degrees. Floating white testimonial quote box at the bottom-right of the image cluster. Right: Text block with 12px uppercase orange tagline, large bold header, and a grid of two stats (e.g., '12+ Michelin Stars') using large Cabinet Grotesk numbers.

### Reservation Section
Centered card component. Background: Gradient from #1A1A1A to #0F0F0F, 60px radius. Width: max-4xl. Internal padding: 80px. Form layout: 2-column grid for inputs (Guest Count, Date). Inputs: black/40 background, 1px border, 16px radius. Submit button: Large pill-shape, #FF6B35 background, uppercase text, shadow-orange glow.

### Footer
4-column grid, background #080808. Column 1: Logo and social icons (circular, thin border). Column 2: Navigation list. Column 3: Contact info. Column 4: Newsletter signup with white/5 background input and a square 'send' button. Bottom bar: Thin top border, 10px uppercase gray-600 text for copyright and legal links.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### 3D Orbital Dish Showcase — An interactive hero element featuring floating imagery and rotating borders.
Construct a central 450px circular container with a 4px orange border (opacity 0.2). Inside, place a food image. Add two absolute-positioned div rings (500px and 400px diameter) with 1px border-white/10. Apply 'spin-slow' (12s) to one and 'spin-slow' reversed to the other. Apply a 6s floating translateY animation to the center image container.

### Perspective Tilt Card — Cards that react to mouse movement for a 3D effect.
Create a container with 'perspective: 1000px'. Inside, a card with 'transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier'. On mousemove, calculate X and Y offset from the center of the viewport (speed factor 5) and apply 'rotateY' and 'rotateX' transforms to the card to simulate looking around it.

style.description: The style blends 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Display) and 'Satoshi' (Body) for an editorial, high-fashion vibe. The color palette is anchored in deep blacks (#0A0A0A, #0F0F0F) with a primary orange (#FF6B35) and golden gradients. Animations are smooth and continuous, utilizing CSS keyframes for floating (vertical oscillation) and orbital rotations (spinning rings). Micro-interactions include 'tilt' effects on cards and text-gradient masking.
